stages.advice: Play the story straight through. The chapter trophies and the named-mission trophies pop as you go; do not skip cutscenes or side content yet, just learn the map and the controls.
stages.title: Story — Chapters 1–2

stages.advice: Keep pushing the story. The remaining chapter and mission trophies land here. Start noting which activities you enjoy — you will grind several of them later.
stages.title: Story — Chapters 3–4

stages.advice: Finish the final mission for the gold, then open the in-game stats page: 100% completion is a checklist of everything else on this page. From here on, work stage by stage.
stages.title: Finale & the long road

stages.advice: This is the stage that decides your platinum. Stranger strands and character arcs can close as the story advances, so finish every strand as soon as its marker appears. Eleven trophies here are flagged missable — clear them before the finale, not after.
stages.title: Strangers & side strands — do these NOW

stages.advice: The skill grinds: shooting range golds, drone races, stunt and challenge counters, races and the arcade. All repeatable, so chip away at them between other stages.
stages.title: Activities & skills

stages.advice: Sweep the map region by region: meditation spots, card sets, WAiNK tags, vehicles, areas and garages. A systematic sweep beats random wandering — tick each region off as you finish it.
stages.title: Collectibles & exploration

stages.advice: Robberies, vaults, trucks, gang operations and the money trophies. Plan each job's escape before you go in, and launder Marked Bills through your contacts as you earn them.
stages.title: Crime & chaos

stages.advice: The odd ones: a cocktail on Ocean Beach, bowling, the partnership moment, the strange event, and the 500 choices. Then the platinum pops. If you are short on choices, a second playthrough with different picks closes the gap.
stages.title: Moments & cleanup

subtitle: Eight stages, in the order that wastes the least time. Story first, strands while they are open, then the long grinds last.
title: Road to the Platinum
